{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Calculate total orders and converted orders per segment
total_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment').size()
converted_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion rate as percentage
df_rates = pd.DataFrame({
    'total': total_by_segment,
    'converted': converted_by_segment,
    'conversion_rate_percent': (converted_by_segment / total_by_segment) * 100
})

# Print the full result to capture all numbers for evidence
df_rates"}
